headline: Ravens Regime: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Ravens Regime is projected #5 of 16 with a 635.90 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Tyler Warren, Lamar Jackson, and Derrick Henry. The immediate priority is improving the RB slot without weakening that core.

latest_trade.summary: On July 15, Ravens Regime traded with Northside Kings and acquired Tyler Warren while sending RJ Harvey, Bhayshul Tuten, 2026 Round 2 (Rapid Valley Annihilation). Tyler Warren is now the current TE starter at 97.1 C-AVI and 90.1 D-AVI; The deal sent out 1 draft asset, reducing future flexibility.

gap_closing_moves: Raise the RB slot above Kyle Monangai's 54.5 C-AVI baseline; a replacement near 77.1 C-AVI would directly attack the 22.60-point projected gap to SmokyValleyWheatWarriors.
Use draft capital as a targeted sweetener for a verified starting-lineup upgrade, not for additional bench depth.
